headline: B200 index rises +2% over 7 days to $7.99 while other tracked GPUs hold steady.
bullets: B200 led the week with a +2% move, reaching a $7.99 index; RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest at $5.98 versus a $14.12 hyperscaler median.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with hyperscalers at $10.68 versus $4.07 for neoclouds.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, and RunPod Community Cloud lists it at $0.50.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, despite a low $2.70 index.
H200 sits at a $5.40 index with a +95% hyperscaler premium, ranging from $3.59 at RunPod Community Cloud to $10.30 at hyperscalers.
watch: Whether B200's +2% weekly gain extends and spreads to other GPUs that held steady this week.
